subject: maths
title: Primary 2 Shapes and Patterns: 2D Shapes, Colour, Size and Turns
seo_title: P2 2D Shapes and Patterns Worksheets: Free Primary 2 Maths with Answers (MOE Syllabus)
standard_text: Making and completing patterns with 2D shapes according to size, shape, colour and orientation
meta_desc: Free P2 maths practice: name 2D shapes and complete patterns by shape, colour, size and turns. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Find the core: the part of the pattern that repeats.
key_sub: Red circle, blue square, blue square, red circle … The core is red circle, blue square, blue square, so next comes a blue square.
body_html:
The 2D shapes

Count the sides and the corners. Look for curved sides.

ShapeStraight sidesCurved sides
rectangle4 (2 long, 2 short)0
square4 (all the same)0
triangle30
circle01
half circle11
quarter circle21

A turned shape keeps its name. A square that is turned is still a square.

Repeating patterns and the core

A repeating pattern has a part that repeats again and again. That part is the core. Find the core. Then say the pattern out loud to check it.

Size and turns

A pattern can change the size (big, small) or the way a shape is turned.

When two things change

Look at one thing at a time. First the shape. Then the colour (or the size).

Two things change

What comes next in the pattern above?

Shape 7: the shapes go circle, square, so it is a circle. The colours go red, blue, yellow, so shape 7 is red.

Answer: red circle

Missing shape

red, blue, blue, red, ☐, blue, red

The core is red, blue, blue. After red come two blues.

Answer: blue

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Wrong core: red, blue, blue has the core “red, blue”Say the pattern again and again to check
Only looking at the colourCheck the shape, the size and the turn too
A turned square is “not a square”Count the sides. Turning does not change the name
Repeating the last shapeFind where the row stops in the core, then take the next one

faq.q: What 2D shapes are taught in Primary 2 maths?
faq.a: Primary 2 students name and describe rectangles, squares, triangles, circles, half circles and quarter circles. They also make and complete patterns with these shapes.

faq.q: How do I help my child with shape patterns?
faq.a: Ask your child to find the core, the part that repeats, and say it out loud. Then check the shape, colour, size and turn one at a time.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake in pattern questions?
faq.a: Children often look only at the colour and pick a shape with the right colour but the wrong shape. Another mistake is a core that is too short, like “red, blue” for red, blue, blue.

faq.q: Is this in the MOE syllabus?
faq.a: Yes. Making and completing patterns with 2D shapes by size, shape, colour and orientation is part of Geometry in the MOE 2021 Primary 2 Mathematics syllabus.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It is round all the way. It has no straight sides and no corners. It is a circle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides that are all the same length and 4 corners. It is a square.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides and 4 corners. Two sides are long and two sides are short. It is a rectangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 1 curved side and 1 straight side. It is half of a circle: a half circle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side. 4 of them make a circle. It is a quarter circle.

items.q: How many straight sides does a triangle have?
items.e: A triangle has 3 straight sides and 3 corners.

items.q: Which shape has no straight sides and no corners?
items.e: A circle is round all the way. A half circle and a quarter circle have straight sides too.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides and 4 corners, with 2 long sides and 2 short sides. It is standing up, but it is still a rectangle.

items.q: How many straight sides does a half circle have?
items.e: A half circle has 1 straight side and 1 curved side. The curved side is not straight.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It points down, but it is still a triangle. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: How many corners does a rectangle have?
items.e: A rectangle has 4 sides and 4 corners, the same as a square.

items.q: This shape has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side. What is it?
items.e: A half circle has only 1 straight side. A triangle has no curved side. It is a quarter circle.

items.q: Which shape is a square?
items.e: A square has 4 sides of the same length. The rectangle has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. The square is B.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 sides of the same length and 4 corners. It is turned, but it is still a square.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side. It is turned, but it is still a quarter circle.

items.q: Which shape is a quarter circle?
items.e: A quarter circle has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side. It is turned here, but it is still a quarter circle: B.

items.q: Put these 4 quarter circles together. What shape do they make?
items.e: Each piece is a quarter circle. 4 quarters make a whole circle. 2 of them make a half circle.

items.q: Put these 2 squares side by side. What shape do they make?
items.e: The new shape has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. It is a rectangle, not a bigger square.

items.q: How many triangles are there?
items.e: A triangle has 3 straight sides. Count them all, also the turned ones and the small one: 4. The quarter circle is not a triangle. It has a curved side.

sets.title: What comes next? Shape and colour

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is red circle, red square. Then it starts again. So next comes a red square. A circle is always followed by a square.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The colours go blue, yellow, then start again. So next comes a blue triangle. Only the colour changes. The shape is always a triangle.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is green triangle, green circle, green rectangle. Then it starts again. So next comes a green circle.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The colours go red, blue, blue, then start again. So next comes a blue square. After red come two blues. The row ends with red, blue, so one more blue comes next.

items.q: What is the core of this pattern?
items.e: The core is the part that repeats: circle, square, square. “circle, square” is too short. After a circle come two squares.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is yellow circle, blue triangle. Then it starts again. So next comes a blue triangle. Look at the shape and the colour.

items.q: What is the core of this pattern?
items.e: The colours go blue, blue, green, then start again. The core is blue, blue, green. “blue, blue, green, blue” is too long. It goes into the next core.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is green half circle, green half circle, red square. Then it starts again. So next comes a red square. There are two green half circles in each core, not one.

items.q: Which letters show the same pattern?
c: A B A B A B
A B C A B C
A B B A B B
A A B A A B
items.e: Triangle is A. Half circle is B. Triangle, half circle, half circle is A, B, B. So it is A B B A B B.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is red circle, blue square, yellow triangle. Then it starts again. So next comes a blue square.

items.q: How many shapes are in the core of this pattern?
items.e: The core is red, red, yellow, yellow. That is 4 shapes. 2 is the number of colours, not shapes.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is blue quarter circle, yellow circle, yellow circle. Then it starts again. So next comes a yellow circle. There are two yellow circles in each core.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is red circle, red triangle, blue square. Then it starts again. So next comes a red circle. Red triangle has the right colour but the wrong shape. Look at the shape too, not only the colour.

items.q: Which letters show the same pattern?
c: A A B B A A B B
A B A B A B A B
A B B A A B B A
A A B A A B A A
items.e: Green is A. Red is B. Two green, two red: A, A, B, B. So it is A A B B A A B B.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is blue square, blue square, yellow circle, yellow circle. Then it starts again. So next comes a blue square. Two blue squares, then two yellow circles.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What are the next two shapes?
items.e: The core is blue square, red circle, red circle. The row ends with a full core. So it starts again: blue square, red circle.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is yellow rectangle, green triangle, green circle. Then it starts again. So next comes a green triangle. Green circle has the right colour but the wrong shape.

items.q: Ethan makes a pattern: triangle, square. He makes one mistake. Which shape is wrong?
items.e: Triangles go at 1, 3, 5 and 7. Squares go at 2, 4, 6 and 8. Shape 6 is a triangle, so it is the mistake.

items.q: Ali makes a pattern with paper shapes: square, circle, circle. He makes the core 4 times. How many circles does he use?
items.e: Each core has 2 circles. 4 cores: 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 8 circles. 4 counts only 1 circle in each core.

items.q: Hui Min sticks shapes on a card for Children’s Day: red circle, blue square, blue square, red circle, blue square, blue square … What is the 9th shape?
items.e: The core has 3 shapes. Red circles are at 1, 4 and 7. Then 8 and 9 are blue squares. So the 9th shape is a blue square.

sets.title: Patterns with size and turned shapes

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is big circle, small circle. Then it starts again. So next comes a small circle. Only the size changes.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is triangle pointing up, triangle pointing down. Then it starts again. So next comes the triangle pointing down: B. The triangle turns over each time.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is big square, big square, small square. Then it starts again. So next comes a small square. There are two big squares in each core, then one small square.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is half circle with its curved side up, half circle with its curved side down. Then it starts again. So next comes the half circle with its curved side up: A.

items.q: How does the triangle change each time?
items.e: Every shape is a blue triangle of the same size. It points up, right, down, left. So it turns a quarter turn each time.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is rectangle lying down, rectangle standing up. Then it starts again. So next comes the rectangle standing up: B. The rectangle is lying down, then standing up.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is small triangle, big triangle, big triangle. Then it starts again. So next comes a big triangle.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is flat square, turned square. Then it starts again. So next comes the flat square: D. A turned square is still a square.

items.q: How does the half circle change?
items.e: Every shape is a red half circle with the curved side up. One is big, two are small. So it changes size.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is big triangle, small triangle, small triangle. Then it starts again. So next comes the big triangle: C. Look at the size as well as the shape.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is triangle pointing up, triangle pointing right, triangle pointing down, triangle pointing left. Then it starts again. So next comes the triangle pointing down: D. The triangle turns a quarter turn each time, like the hands of a clock.

items.q: What is the core of this pattern?
items.e: The sizes go big, small, small, then start again. The core is big, small, small. “big, small” is too short.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is half circle with its curved side up, half circle with its curved side up, half circle with its curved side down. Then it starts again. So next comes the half circle with its curved side up: B.

items.q: How many shapes are in the core of this pattern?
items.e: The quarter circle turns 4 times, then it is back where it started. The core has 4 shapes.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is quarter circle with its corner at the bottom left, quarter circle with its corner at the top left, quarter circle with its corner at the top right, quarter circle with its corner at the bottom right. Then it starts again. So next comes the quarter circle with its corner at the bottom right: C. The quarter circle turns a quarter turn each time.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is half circle with its curved side up, half circle with its curved side right, half circle with its curved side down, half circle with its curved side left. Then it starts again. So next comes the half circle with its curved side right: A. The curved side turns a quarter turn each time.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is triangle pointing up, triangle pointing up, triangle pointing down, triangle pointing down. Then it starts again. So next comes the triangle pointing up: A. Two point up, then two point down.

items.q: The triangle should turn a quarter turn each time. One triangle is wrong. Which one?
items.e: The triangle points up, right, down, left, then again. Shape 6 should point right. It points left, so shape 6 is wrong.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is half circle with its curved side left, half circle with its curved side right, half circle with its curved side right. Then it starts again. So next comes the half circle with its curved side right: D.

items.q: Kumar puts quarter circle tiles in a row. Each tile turns a quarter turn. These are the first 4 tiles. What does the 9th tile look like?
items.e: The core has 4 tiles. Tiles 1, 5 and 9 look the same. So the 9th tile looks like the 1st: C.

items.q: One shape is missing. What is it?
items.e: The core is red circle, red square. Then it starts again. Say the pattern from the start: red circle, red square, red circle, red square. The missing shape is a red square.

items.q: One shape is missing. What is it?
items.e: The colours go red, blue, blue, then start again. Say the pattern from the start: red triangle, blue triangle, blue triangle, red triangle, blue triangle. The missing shape is a blue triangle.

items.q: One shape is missing. What is it?
items.e: The core is blue square, blue triangle, blue circle. Then it starts again. Say the pattern from the start: blue square, blue triangle, blue circle, blue square, blue triangle. The missing shape is a blue triangle.

items.q: One shape is missing. Which shape goes in the box?
items.e: The core is triangle pointing up, triangle pointing down. Then it starts again. Shape 5 is the triangle pointing up: D. Check it with the shapes on both sides.

items.q: One shape is missing. What is it?
items.e: The core is big square, small square. Then it starts again. Say the pattern from the start: big square, small square, big square, small square. The missing shape is a small square.

items.q: One shape is missing. What is it?
items.e: The core is yellow circle, red square, blue triangle. Then it starts again. Say the pattern from the start: yellow circle, red square, blue triangle, yellow circle, red square. The missing shape is a red square.

items.q: One shape is missing. What is it?
items.e: The core is yellow half circle, yellow half circle, green rectangle. Then it starts again. Say the pattern from the start: yellow half circle, yellow half circle, green rectangle, yellow half circle, yellow half circle, green rectangle. The missing shape is a green rectangle.

items.q: One shape is missing. Which shape goes in the box?
items.e: The core is rectangle lying down, rectangle standing up. Then it starts again. Shape 4 is the rectangle standing up: B. Check it with the shapes on both sides.

items.q: One shape is missing. What is it?
items.e: The colours go green, green, blue, blue, then start again. Say the pattern from the start: green circle, green circle, blue circle, blue circle, green circle, green circle. The missing shape is a green circle.

items.q: One shape is missing. Which shape goes in the box?
items.e: The core is triangle pointing up, triangle pointing right, triangle pointing down, triangle pointing left. Then it starts again. Shape 6 is the triangle pointing right: A. Check it with the shapes on both sides.

items.q: One shape is missing. What is it?
items.e: The core is red circle, red triangle, blue square. Then it starts again. Say the pattern from the start: red circle, red triangle, blue square, red circle, red triangle. The missing shape is a red triangle. Red circle has the right colour but the wrong shape.

items.q: One shape is missing. Which shape goes in the box?
items.e: The core is half circle with its curved side up, half circle with its curved side down, half circle with its curved side down. Then it starts again. Shape 5 is the half circle with its curved side down: C. Check it with the shapes on both sides.

items.q: One shape is missing. What is it?
items.e: The core is big triangle, small triangle, small triangle. Then it starts again. Say the pattern from the start: big triangle, small triangle, small triangle, big triangle, small triangle, small triangle. The missing shape is a small triangle.

items.q: One shape is missing. Which shape goes in the box?
items.e: The core is quarter circle with its corner at the bottom left, quarter circle with its corner at the top left, quarter circle with its corner at the top right, quarter circle with its corner at the bottom right. Then it starts again. Shape 3 is the quarter circle with its corner at the top right: A. Check it with the shapes on both sides.

items.q: Siti makes a bracelet with beads in a pattern. One bead falls off. What colour is the missing bead?
items.e: The colours go red, yellow, blue, then start again. Bead 4 is red, so bead 5 is yellow. Check: bead 6 is blue.

items.q: One shape is missing. Which shape goes in the box?
items.e: The core is flat square, turned square, turned square. Then it starts again. Shape 5 is the turned square: A. Check it with the shapes on both sides.

items.q: Two shapes are missing. What are they, in order?
items.e: The core is blue square, red circle. Shape 3 is a blue square. Shape 6 is a red circle. So the answer is blue square, red circle.

items.q: One shape is missing. Which shape goes in the box?
items.e: The core is half circle with its curved side up, half circle with its curved side right, half circle with its curved side down, half circle with its curved side left. Then it starts again. Shape 7 is the half circle with its curved side down: D. Check it with the shapes on both sides.

items.q: Two shapes are missing. What are they, in order?
items.e: The colours go yellow, green, green. Shape 3 is green, so a new core starts at shape 4: yellow triangle, green triangle.

items.q: Mr Tan puts a row of tiles on the kitchen wall of his HDB flat. One tile is missing. Which tile goes in the gap?
items.e: The core is quarter circle with its corner at the bottom left, quarter circle with its corner at the top right. Then it starts again. Shape 6 is the quarter circle with its corner at the top right: C. Check it with the shapes on both sides.

items.q: Which two things change in this pattern?
items.e: The shapes go circle, square. The colours go red, blue. The size stays the same. So shape and colour change. Do not look only at the colour.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is big blue circle, small yellow circle. Then it starts again. So next comes a small yellow circle. Big yellow circle has the right colour but the wrong size.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The core is big triangle, small square. Then it starts again. So next comes a small square.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The core is red triangle pointing up, blue triangle pointing down. Then it starts again. So next comes the blue triangle pointing down: D. Check the colour and the turn.

items.q: Which two things change in this pattern?
items.e: The sizes go big, small. The colours go yellow, red. Every shape is a square. So size and colour change. Look at the size, not only the colour.

items.q: Which two things change in this pattern?
items.e: The triangles go big, small. They point up, then down. The colour stays blue. So size and turn change.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The shapes go circle, square. The colours go red, blue, yellow. So next comes a blue square. Even places are squares. The colours start again at shape 7 (red), so shape 8 is blue.

items.q: One shape is missing. What is it?
items.e: The colours go red, red, blue. The sizes go big, small. Say the pattern from the start: big red square, small red square, big blue square, small red square, big red square. The missing shape is a big red square.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The shapes go triangle, circle, circle. The colours go green, yellow. So next comes a yellow circle. Work out the shape and the colour one at a time.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The sizes go big, big, small. The turns go curved side up, curved side down. So next comes the small half circle with its curved side up: B.

items.q: Priya sticks paper shapes on the classroom wall for Children’s Day. What comes next?
items.e: The shapes go rectangle, circle. The colours go red, red, yellow, yellow. So next comes a red rectangle.

items.q: One shape is missing. Which shape goes in the box?
items.e: The colours go yellow, yellow, red. The turns go lying down, standing up. Shape 5 is the yellow rectangle lying down: B. Check it with the shapes on both sides.

items.q: The pattern repeats. What comes next?
items.e: The shapes go square, triangle, circle. The sizes go big, small. So next comes a big circle.

items.q: The pattern keeps going. What is the 10th shape?
items.e: The shapes go circle, triangle, so even places are triangles. The colours go blue, blue, yellow, so yellow is at 3, 6 and 9. The 10th shape is a blue triangle.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The colours go blue, green. The turns go corner at the bottom left, corner at the top left, corner at the top right, corner at the bottom right. So next comes the blue quarter circle with its corner at the top right: A.

items.q: The pattern repeats. Which shape comes next?
items.e: The sizes go big, small. The turns go pointing up, pointing right, pointing down, pointing left. So next comes the small triangle pointing left: C.

items.q: Jun Jie draws shapes on a Chinese New Year card: big red circle, small yellow square, big red circle, small yellow square … He draws 9 shapes. How many are small yellow squares?
items.e: The small yellow squares are at 2, 4, 6 and 8. That is 4. 5 counts the big red circles at 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9.

items.q: The pattern keeps going. What is the 12th shape?
items.e: The colours go red, blue, so even places are blue. The sizes go big, small, small, so big is at 1, 4, 7 and 10. Then 11 and 12 are small. The 12th shape is a small blue circle.

items.q: Mdm Wong makes a pattern. The shapes go circle, triangle, square, then start again. The colours go red, blue, then start again. What is the 7th shape?
items.e: Shapes: circle, triangle, square, circle, triangle, square, circle. Colours: red, blue, red, blue, red, blue, red. So the 7th shape is a red circle.

items.q: Farah makes a pattern with half circle stickers. One sticker is missing. Which one goes in the box?
items.e: The sizes go big, small. The turns go curved side up, curved side right, curved side down, curved side left. Shape 6 is the small half circle with its curved side right: A. Check it with the shapes on both sides.
